	construction_time = slow_construction_time
	effect_desc = {
		desc = unlocks_building_desc
		desc = dragon_kiln_effect_desc
	}

	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_castle_city_church = { LEVEL = 01 }
		building_requirement_tribal = no
		county.holder.culture = { has_cultural_parameter = unlock_dragon_kiln_buildings }
	
            }
        }
    }

	can_construct_showing_failures_only = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		culture = { has_cultural_parameter = unlock_dragon_kiln_buildings }
		building_requirement_no_great_barracks_project = yes
	
            }
        }
    }

	show_disabled = yes

	cost_gold = expensive_building_tier_3_cost

	character_modifier = {
		court_grandeur_baseline_add = 4
		character_capital_county_monthly_prosperity_growth_add = 0.2

	province_modifier = {
		monthly_artisan_tax = good_building_tax_tier_4
		trade_good_ceramics_production_add = 5
	}
	market_modifier = {
		trade_good_ceramics_buy_price_mult = precious_producer_buy_price_mult
	}

tower_of_silence_01 = {
	construction_time = slow_construction_time

	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_tribal = no
		building_requirement_castle_city_church = { LEVEL = 01 }
		scope:holder = {
			rite = { rite_has_parameter = can_build_towers_of_silence_active }
		}
	
            }
        }
    }

	is_enabled = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = tower_of_silence_01.tt.county_not_tos_users
			county.rite = { rite_has_parameter = can_build_towers_of_silence_active }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = tower_of_silence_01.tt.liege_not_approve_of_burial
			scope:holder.liege ?= {
				rite = {
					NOT = { rite_has_parameter = can_build_towers_of_silence_active }
				}
			}
		}
		county.holder = {
			rite = { rite_has_parameter = can_build_towers_of_silence_active }
		}
	
            }
        }
    }
	show_disabled = yes

	cost_gold = expensive_building_tier_5_cost

	character_modifier = {
		same_faith_opinion = 10
		zealot_opinion = 10
		zealot_tax_contribution_mult = 0.2
		zealot_levy_contribution_mult = 0.2
		monthly_piety = 1
		owned_legend_spread_mult = 0.2
		legitimacy_gain_mult = 0.3
	}
	duchy_capital_county_modifier = {
		popular_opinion_add = 10
		epidemic_resistance = 10
		control_baseline_add = 5
	}
	on_complete = {
		#Regular Mandala Boon
		mandala_built_piety_duchy_building_t3_effect = yes
	}

	type_icon = "duchy_buildings/tower_of_silence.dds"

	flag = duchy_building
	flag = fully_upgraded_duchy_capital_building

	ai_value = {
		base = 11
		ai_pious_building_preference_modifier = yes
		ai_opinion_baseline_building_modifier = { VALUE = 30 }
		modifier = { # Less likely when the AI should build regular buildings first
			factor = 0.1
			scope:holder = { ai_should_focus_on_building_in_their_capital = yes }
		}
		ai_popular_opinion_need_modifier = yes
		ai_duchy_district_building_modifier = { LEVEL = 1 }
	}
}

great_megalith_01 = {
	construction_time = very_slow_construction_time

	can_construct_potential = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		building_requirement_tribal = no
		building_requirement_castle_city_church = { LEVEL = 01 }
		scope:holder = {
			rite = {
				rite_has_parameter = can_build_megaliths
			}
		}
	
            }
        }
    }

	is_enabled = {
        OR = {
            has_variable = DI_tm_building_edit_active
            AND = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = province_is_of_a_megalith_faith_tt
			county.rite = { rite_has_parameter = can_build_megaliths }
		}
	
            }
        }
    }
	show_disabled = yes

	cost_gold = expensive_building_tier_3_cost

	character_modifier = {
		monthly_learning_lifestyle_xp_gain_mult = 0.1
		monthly_piety = 0.25
		monthly_dynasty_prestige_mult = 0.05
		naval_movement_speed_mult = 0.1
	}
	duchy_capital_county_modifier = {
		popular_opinion_add = 5
	}
	province_modifier = {
		monthly_religious_tax = good_building_tax_tier_3
	}
	trade_good_need = {
		trade_good = trade_good_stone
		amount = basic_resource_need
